projects.title: Tradewave
projects.description: A full B2B e-commerce ecosystem — mobile app for buyers & web admin panel for vendors — handling bulk orders, inventory, and real-time tracking.
projects.longDescription:
TradeWave revolutionizes B2B commerce by providing a comprehensive ecosystem for vendors and business customers.

The platform consists of two main components: a powerful Mobile App built with React Native for customers to browse catalogs, place bulk orders, and track shipments; and a sophisticated Web Admin Panel for vendors to manage inventory, analyze sales data, and process orders efficiently. It handles complex business logic like bulk pricing, minimum order quantities, and vendor-specific catalogs.
projects.impact: Streamlines B2B ordering — reducing order processing time through a unified vendor + buyer platform.

projects.title: CollaborateX
projects.description: A real-time video conferencing platform that lets distributed teams meet, present, and collaborate without friction — no downloads required.
projects.longDescription:
CollaborateX is a cutting-edge video conferencing solution designed to bridge the gap between remote teams. Built with performance and scalability in mind, it leverages WebRTC for low-latency peer-to-peer communication.

Users can create instant meeting rooms, share their screens for presentations, and communicate via real-time chat. The application features a modern, intuitive interface that makes joining calls seamless without complex software installations.
projects.impact: Enables real-time collaboration with sub-200ms latency using WebRTC peer-to-peer connections.
features: Real-time HD Video & Audio via WebRTC

architecture.stateManagement: Zustand — chosen for its minimal boilerplate and lightweight footprint over Redux. Since CollaborateX is a real-time UI-heavy app, Zustand's direct store access avoids unnecessary re-renders and keeps call state (participants, mute, stream) snappy.
architecture.backendStructure: MVC pattern with Express.js: routes → controllers → services → models. Socket.io runs on the same server instance, enabling seamless event emission from REST controllers into active WebSocket rooms.
architecture.apiDesign: RESTful endpoints handle room creation, auth, and user management. WebRTC signaling (offer/answer/ICE candidates) is routed via Socket.io events for ultra-low latency, avoiding HTTP round-trip overhead for real-time data.
architecture.authentication: JWT-based authentication with short-lived access tokens and refresh tokens stored in HTTP-only cookies. Prevents XSS attacks while maintaining seamless session continuity across page reloads.
architecture.deployment: Frontend deployed on Vercel with automatic CI/CD from the main branch. Backend hosted on Render with a health-check endpoint keeping the instance warm. MongoDB Atlas handles cloud database with connection pooling.

projects.title: Scoutly
projects.description: An autonomous AI job search & application co-pilot — parses resumes, scores job fit using Gemini AI, drafts cover letters, and applies via Gmail API.
projects.longDescription:
Scoutly (AI Job Hunter Agent) is an intelligent, autonomous job hunting platform engineered to streamline the end-to-end job discovery and application lifecycle.

The system is built as a production-grade full-stack application featuring a high-performance Next.js 16 (React 19) frontend and a modular Express.js TypeScript backend. Scoutly parses candidate resume PDFs, performs semantic skill extraction and gap analysis against live ATS job openings using Google Gemini AI, and generates tailored cover letters. With integrated Google OAuth 2.0 and the Gmail API, candidates can review, customize, and dispatch personalized job applications with attached resumes in a single click.
projects.impact: Automates repetitive job search workflows with sub-second AI fit scoring, semantic skill-gap analysis, and verified direct Gmail dispatch.
features: Automated Resume PDF Parsing & Skill Extraction
Multi-Tier ATS Job Ingestion & Discovery Pipeline
Gemini AI Semantic Fit Scoring & Gap Analysis
Personalized Cover Letter & Cold Email Generation
Direct One-Click Gmail API Application Dispatch
Interactive Status Tracking Dashboard & Kanban Board

architecture.stateManagement: Custom React hooks (useJobs) paired with URL search params and local component state for filters, search queries, modal triggers, and job application lifecycle transitions.
architecture.backendStructure: Modular layered MVC architecture in TypeScript: REST routing, auth & upload middlewares, controllers, and decoupled service layers isolating Gemini AI analysis, Gmail dispatch, job scraping, and MongoDB models.
architecture.apiDesign: RESTful JSON endpoints for resume ingestion (multipart form-data), AI-powered job discovery queries, fit analysis computation, tailored application cover letter generation, and Gmail API dispatch.
architecture.authentication: Google OAuth 2.0 authorization with Google APIs integration, generating JWT tokens stored securely on the client with HTTP-only cookies and CSRF protections.
architecture.deployment: Frontend configured for Next.js App Router deployment on Vercel; Express server containerized with MongoDB Atlas cluster and Google Cloud Console OAuth integration.

projects.title: Jancode
projects.description: A 3D website portfolio for a software service company.
projects.longDescription: A visually striking 3D website portfolio designed for a software service company. This project pushes the boundaries of web experiences with interactive 3D elements, creating an immersive journey for visitors exploring the company's offerings.
projects.impact: Delivers an engaging and modern user experience with interactive 3D visuals.

projects.title: TaskFlow
projects.description: A continuous learning platform for users with push notifications, custom tasks, and management by admins and users.
projects.longDescription: TaskFlow is a comprehensive continuous learning platform that empowers users to acquire new skills through customized tasks. It features a robust push notification system to keep users engaged and on track. The platform offers dedicated portals for both admins and users to seamlessly manage learning objectives and track progress.
projects.impact: Enhances user engagement and skill acquisition through targeted tasks and timely notifications.

projects.title: Vanguard
projects.description: The permission layer for sovereign AI agents — intercepting API calls, enforcing zero-trust gating, and managing Auth0 Token Vaults.
projects.longDescription:
Vanguard is a secure intermediary layer designed for the AI era. It intercepts every action an autonomous AI agent attempts, evaluates it against a permission intelligence engine, and securely executes external APIs using Auth0 for identity and a Vault-based token access model.

By transforming AI systems from execution-first to control-first, Vanguard eliminates uncontrolled API actions. High-risk actions require user approval via mobile push alerts, and sensitive tokens (Gmail, Slack) are never exposed to the agent.
projects.impact: Shifts AI agent security from implicit trust to explicit zero-trust control, with real-time push approvals and immutable audit trails.
features: Interactive Mobile Push Approvals (Allow Once / Always / Deny)
Zero-Trust Execution Layer Shielding API Tokens from LLMs

architecture.stateManagement: React Native state combined with Expo notifications listener for handling real-time permission requests, rule escalation, and action approvals.
architecture.backendStructure: Modular NestJS architecture dividing the permission engine, Auth0 token vault gateway, external proxy dispatchers, and audit log persistence.
architecture.apiDesign: Secure proxy endpoints intercepting agent action payloads, evaluating risk scores, and generating step-up approval triggers.
architecture.authentication: Enterprise-grade Auth0 PKCE flow on mobile with M2M client credential grants and scoped token issuance via Token Vault.
architecture.deployment: NestJS backend hosted as Docker containers; mobile app distributed via Expo Application Services (EAS).

projects.title: LiveQuiz AI
projects.description: An AI-powered YouTube Live quiz & audience polling platform enabling streamers to run interactive chat polls with live leaderboards.
projects.longDescription:
LiveQuiz AI is an interactive platform built for content creators, educators, and live streamers on YouTube. Hosts can dynamically generate quizzes from any topic using AI, run each question as an A–D YouTube Live Chat poll, reveal explanations, and review session feedback.

The system polls YouTube chat messages in real time, deduplicates voters, tallies votes dynamically, and maintains cumulative participant scores on an interactive live leaderboard.
projects.impact: Boosts live stream audience engagement by automating real-time YouTube chat polling and leaderboard gamification.
features: Dynamic AI Quiz Generation by Topic
Official YouTube Live Chat API & Broadcast Detection
Real-Time Chat Message Ingestion & Deduplicated Tallying
OBS Stream Overlay Mode for Live Broadcasting

architecture.stateManagement: Lightweight client state with polling status intervals synchronized against backend poll state machines.
architecture.backendStructure: Express server coordinating OAuth token refreshes, broadcast detection, YouTube chat polling intervals, and session history.
architecture.apiDesign: REST endpoints for poll initiation, status polling, and score settlement with YouTube Live Chat API integrations.
architecture.authentication: Google OAuth 2.0 with offline refresh tokens for long-running live broadcast permissions.
architecture.deployment: Client deployable on Vercel or packaged with Electron for desktop; Node server deployable on Render or Railway.

projects.title: ChangeGuard
projects.description: Evidence-first regression reviewer for AI-generated JS/TS diffs — epistemic separation of verifiable facts from model hypotheses.
projects.longDescription:
ChangeGuard is a high-speed, client-side regression detection and evidence analysis tool designed to inspect AI-generated pull requests and diffs.

AI coding agents frequently take silent shortcuts when tests fail—such as deleting assertions, swallowing errors in empty catch blocks, or skipping test cases. ChangeGuard acts as an objective referee by enforcing an epistemic boundary: extracting deterministic AST facts and separating verifiable code changes from unverified model hypotheses.
projects.impact: Prevents silent AI regression risks with 100% deterministic, zero-hallucination diff analysis directly in the browser.
features: Deterministic AST-Based Assertion & Error Swallowing Checks
Epistemic Separation of Visible Facts vs. LLM Hypotheses
Instant Client-Side Evaluation with Zero Server Roundtrips
Support for Unified Git Diffs and Multi-File Reviews
Built-in Test Suite with 48+ Regression Scenarios

projects.title: Academic Atelier
projects.description: A modern School ERP & Student Portal streamlining academic operations, attendance tracking, schedules, and fee management.
projects.longDescription:
Academic Atelier (EduPortal) is a comprehensive academic ERP platform designed for students, teachers, and administrators. Built with Expo, React Native, and React, it provides role-specific dashboards to view real-time class timetables, track attendance metrics, manage fee balances with instant breakdowns, and interact with an integrated AI chat support system.

The system bridges administrative workflows with clean, responsive interfaces across mobile and web platforms, empowering educational institutions with transparent, automated operational oversight.
projects.impact: Improved academic efficiency, real-time insights, automated fee handling, and streamlined communication for students and faculty.
features: Centralized Academic Dashboard for Students & Faculty
Smart Weekly Timetables & Class Lecture Tracking
Transparent Fee Breakdown, Due Alerts & Payments
Interactive AI Chat Support for Academic Assistance

architecture.stateManagement: Redux Toolkit combined with custom query hooks for managing global session state, offline-first timetable caching, attendance records, and conversational AI chat streams.
architecture.backendStructure: Modular layered architecture dividing role-based route guards, academic scheduling controllers, invoice computation services, and relational database schemas.
architecture.apiDesign: RESTful endpoints providing institutional authentication, student record retrieval, attendance tally computations, and streamed chat completions.
architecture.authentication: Institutional JWT credentials enforcing strict role-based access control (RBAC) to separate student and faculty data access.
architecture.deployment: Mobile application deployed through Expo Application Services (EAS); web portal deployed on Vercel with automated CI/CD.
